description:
Community Service Project Successfully Completed – 30th October 🌟
With the generous support of our donors, we were able to serve breakfast today to 250 cancer patients and their relatives staying at Gadge Maharaj.
🙏 Heartfelt gratitude to all our generous donors for their kindness, compassion, and valuable contribution in making this meaningful initiative a success.
A special thanks to Rtn. Ameet Dalal, Rtn. Prita Shah, Rtn. Shilpa Vora, Rtn. Reema Saraf and Jyoti Vekaria for their valuable support and gracious presence.
Service Above Self!
location: • Sant Gadge Maharaj Lane, off Dada Saheb Phalke Marg . Dadar East, Mumbai – 400014, Maharashtra.
